title: CMP-Compliance-Evaluator Output
description: Structured compliance audit result from the CMP-Compliance-Evaluator skill.

cmp_detected.description: True if any recognised CMP script or TCF/USP API evidence is found in the DOM or network signals.

detected_cmp_name.description: Vendor name of the detected CMP (e.g. 'OneTrust', 'Quantcast', 'Didomi'), or null if no CMP is detected or the vendor is unrecognised.

tcf_v2_compliant.description: True only when every ad-server request carrying gdpr=1 also carries a non-empty, structurally valid gdpr_consent TC string.

ccpa_compliant.description: True when us_privacy or __uspapi evidence is present for CA/US-scoped traffic, or when traffic is confirmed to be out of CA/US scope.

risk_severity.description: Aggregate risk level. Critical = likely regulatory violation. Warning = misconfiguration or incomplete signal. Safe = no evidence of violation.

technical_details.description: Pipe-separated diagnostic findings referencing specific URLs, parameter names, and consent string values (truncated to 20 chars).
